# Resizer Lab

> Free, browser-based image toolkit. Resize images in KB or pixels, remove backgrounds, and generate AI images — no uploads, no signup. All resizing runs locally in your browser for full privacy.

Resizer Lab is a privacy-first online image tool. There are no accounts and no server-side processing for resizing or background removal — images never leave your device. The site also publishes long-form guides and tutorials on image optimization, formats, file-size targets, and platform-specific sizing.

## Pages

- [Home / Image Resizer](/): Drag-and-drop resizer with presets, percentage scaling, KB targets, and JPG/PNG/WebP output.
- [Interactive Image Resizer](/image-resizer): Visual resize editor with draggable handles, presets, and exact custom dimensions.
- [Background Remover](/background-remover): In-browser AI background removal — the image is never uploaded.
- [AI Image Generator](/image-generator): Generate images from a text prompt and download them.
- [Image Size Presets](/gallery): Quick-pick preset sizes (passport, Instagram, reel, banner, logo, letter, legal).
- [Guides](/guides): Tutorials and learning paths for image optimization, compression, and platform sizing.
- [Blog](/blog): Articles on image resizing, compression, formats, SEO, and social media sizing.
- [About](/about): What Resizer Lab is and how the privacy-first architecture works.
- [Contact](/contact): Support and feedback.

## Key facts

- Resizing and background removal are 100% client-side (HTML5 Canvas + WebGPU/WASM); nothing is uploaded.
- Supported formats: JPEG/JPG, PNG, WebP.
- Free, unlimited, no signup or watermark.
- Supports exact pixel dimensions, percentage scaling, aspect-ratio lock, and KB file-size targets.
